entries.reason: Horizontal 4-tab FloatingTabBar overflowed the right edge on 390px screens when tabItem paddingHorizontal exceeded 8px or Animated.View lacked flex: 1.
entries.fixRule: Always pass containerStyle={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }} to AnimatedPressable inside flex rows and keep 4-tab paddingHorizontal <= 6px with overflow: hidden.

entries.reason: 3-column card rows using AnimatedPressable overflowed viewport width when flex: 1 was only applied to the inner Pressable instead of Animated.View.
entries.fixRule: Apply flex: 1 and minWidth: 0 to AnimatedPressable containerStyle in multi-column mobile rows.

entries.reason: Repeating identical icon + heading + paragraph cards across every screen makes distinct apps look like the same template.
entries.fixRule: Lead each app with a domain-authentic focal layout (journey map, balance hero, editorial feed, live canvas) matched to its selected design direction.
